<thought>Based on the molecular ion (m/z ≈ 193.11) and the ¹³C NMR data (11 distinct carbons: one carbonyl ~166 ppm, six aromatic carbons, and four aliphatic carbons at ~52, 49, 43, 19 ppm), the most plausible structure is methyl 4‑methoxycinnamate (methyl p‑methoxycinnamate). Its SMILES string is “COC(=O)/C=C/c1ccc(OC)cc1”, which matches the formula C₁₁H₁₂O₃ (M = 192.07 Da, [M+H]⁺ ≈ 193.08 Da) and the observed NMR pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)/C=C/c1ccc(OC)cc1</final_answer>
